        MONSTER_SIZE, MONSTER_SIZE
    )
    monsters.append(monster)

        if monster.left > SCREEN_WIDTH:
            monster.x = 0
        if monster.top > SCREEN_HEIGHT:
            monster.y = 0
        if monster.bottom < 0:
            monster.y = SCREEN_HEIGHT

            monster.x + monster.width > player.x and

            lives -= 1
            if lives <= 0:
                running = False

    # Draw everything

    clock.tick(60)
